title: Credit Control
description:
Credit Controller

Salary: Up to £35,000
Location: Northampton
Type: Full-time- Office Based

We're working with a growing and fast-paced business looking to add an experienced Credit Controller to their finance team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, taking ownership of a ledger, and playing a key role in improving cash flow and business performance.

You'll be responsible for managing customer accounts, proactively chasing outstanding payments, resolving invoice queries, and maintaining accurate records across the sales ledger. The role offers plenty of autonomy and the chance to work closely with multiple departments to ensure timely collections and smooth account management.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing and collecting outstanding debt across an allocated portfolio of accounts.
- Building strong customer relationships to secure timely payments.
- Investigating and resolving invoice and payment queries.
- Maintaining accurate account records and collection notes.
- Producing aged debt reports and supporting month-end activities.
- Working collaboratively with internal teams to resolve issues impacting payment timelines.
- Supporting cash flow forecasting with accurate payment information.

What We're Looking For
- Previous Credit Control experience.
- Strong understanding of debt collection and credit control processes.
- Good Excel skills.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

This is a great opportunity to join a busy finance team where your work will have a direct impact on the success of the business, with opportunities to develop your skills and take ownership of your workload.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

Northamptonshire On-Site £30,000 - £40,000 DOE

We're working with a growing, award-winning business in Northamptonshire that is looking to bring its digital marketing activity in-house for the first time.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys taking ownership, working closely with the wider business, and seeing the direct impact of their work. The company has a genuinely positive, supportive culture with a friendly team environment and strong staff retention.

The Role
- Manage and optimise SEO strategy across the company website
- Take ownership of Google Ads and paid search campaigns
- Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for growth
- Report on campaign performance and marketing ROI
- Work alongside external agencies and suppliers where required
- Help shape and develop the company's long-term digital strategy

About You
- Experience in SEO and PPC/Google Ads
- Confident working independently and taking ownership of projects
- Strong attention to detail
- Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
- Comfortable reporting results to senior stakeholders
- Agency or in-house digital marketing experience considered

What's on Offer?
- £30,000 - £40,000 salary depending on experience
- Full-time, on-site position
- Friendly, collaborative and supportive team
- Positive working culture with a genuine focus on employee wellbeing
- Autonomy to make a real impact and influence marketing strategy
- Long-term progression opportunities within a growing business

title: Insurance Sales Executive
description:
Job Title: Trainee Insurance Advisor - Full Training Provided (No Experience Needed!)

Location: Northampton (Office-based)

Salary: £26,500 - £33,000 (Depending on experience/growth potential)

Hours: Monday - Friday, 08:30 - 17:00 (Plus 1 Saturday morning per month)

Kick start Your Career in Northampton - No Experience Needed!

Stuck in retail, hospitality, or sales, and looking for an office-based career with real progression and professional qualifications?

We are a close-knit, high-energy independent insurance brokerage looking for ambitious, people-focused individuals to join our team. We don't expect you to know anything about insurance-we care about your personality, drive, and communication skills, and we'll teach you the rest.

What's in It for You?
- Earn While You Learn: A competitive starting salary of £26,500 - £33,000, with clear milestones for pay increases.
- Fully Funded Professional Qualifications: We pay for you to gain your Cert CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) professional credentials, boosting your market value.
- Real Career Progression: This isn't just a phone job. You'll get a 360-degree understanding of personal lines, commercial insurance, and client management.
- Solid Work-Life Balance: Standard Monday to Friday hours (with just one Saturday shift a month) so you still have your weekends.
- Great Team Culture: Work in a supportive, friendly environment where your wins are actually celebrated (no corporate micromanagement here).

What You'll Be Doing:
- Talking to clients every day, building genuine rapport, and finding the right insurance policies to protect what matters to them.
- Guiding customers through quotes, renewals, and policy updates over the phone and via email.
- Keeping accurate digital records and managing client portfolios with attention to detail.
- Collaborating with the team to hit collective milestones and earn bonus/incentive rewards.

About You:
- People Person: You're confident, chatty, and naturally good at building trust with anyone.
- Ambitious & Driven: You want a long-term professional career path, not just a stepping-stone job.
- Organised & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating computer systems and keeping track of details.
- Ready to Learn: Willing to study for professional qualifications (good GCSEs, including Maths, are helpful here!).

Ready to start your next chapter? Hit 'Apply Now' and let's chat.

title: Internal Sales
description:
Could you work in Internal Sales driving sales growth in a brilliant Manufacturing business Are you confident in working with external customers and internal teams in an internal engineering sales or internal technical sales role Are you well organised and proactive in progressing customer requirements from initial costing through manufacturing and to dispatch

Kingscroft has been asked to recruit for an Internal Sales candidate for a fast paced manufacturing business. As the ideal candidate you will have had experience of working in a Customer Account Management or an Internal Sales Exec role in a manufacturing , technical or engineering setting. You will be confident of acting as the focal point for customer orders; liaising closely with external sales teams initially and then through engineering, manufacturing, quality and dispatch.

Your key skills and responsibilities will include:

Customer Service Communication
- Act as the primary point of contact for day-to-day customer queries, requests, and issues.
- Respond to telephone, email, and online enquiries promptly and professionally.
- Provide customers with product information, pricing, lead times, and order updates.
- Able to build a quote from material selection through to delivery
- Build strong, positive relationships with existing and potential customers.

Sales Support
- Prepare and issue quotations based on customer needs and company pricing guidelines.
- Follow up on quotes to convert leads and maximize sales opportunities.
- Support external sales representatives with account management and follow-ups.
- Identify upselling or cross-selling opportunities where appropriate.

Order Processing Administration
- Process sales orders accurately, ensuring all details are correct and captured in the system.
- Liaise with production, purchasing, logistics, and finance teams to ensure timely fulfilment of customer orders.
- Maintain customer records and update CRM or ERP systems.
- Monitor stock levels and communicate availability or delays to customers.

Problem Resolution
- Handle customer complaints or issues in a professional and timely manner.
- Investigate and resolve delivery, product, or invoice discrepancies.
- Ensure solutions meet both customer expectations and company policies.

This is a fantastic opportunity to take on a key role for a business that is looking strengthen its internal sales and account management processes to enable continued growth and expansion. Your sales, costing and proactive skill set will vital for your success in this post.

Please apply today for a confidential discussion on the role.

By applying to this role, you will register as a candidate with Kingscroft Professional Resources. Our Privacy Policy explains how we will use your information.

title: Receptionist
description: A receptionist is responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and providing support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties may include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of personal information and assisting patients as required. To act as a central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with the multidisciplinary team member and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The core responsibilities of the receptionist are as follows. On occasion, there may be a requirement to carry out tasks not listed below, that are within the reasonable scope of the role. Maintain and monitor practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, dealing with the callers request appropriately Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as requested Input data as necessary onto patients healthcare records Direct requests for information to relevant team members i.e., SAR, DVLA forms, insurance/solicitors letters Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Carry out system searches as requested Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required Photocopy documentation as required Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards In addition to the core responsibilities, the Receptionist may be requested to; 1. Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary 2. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the rota 3. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead 4. Support admin team, providing cover during absences Scan patient related documents and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare record

title: Administrator
description: A great opportunity to be part of an excellent healthcare team where you will provide valuable administrative support and services to all members of the practice team. With your attention to detail, exceptional customer service skills, and experience of working within a fast paced environment, you will be the ideal addition to the practice family. Job responsibilities: Coding in a health care setting - eg: general practice Management of medical records Administrative support - processing of electronic documents Handling of incoming and outgoing emails, patient and hospital correspondence Customer Service/Effective Communication Experience of working as part of a team but also the ability to work independently when required. Experience of the various Microsoft packages: Word, Excel, Powerpoint. Experience of SystmOne would be advantageous although training will be provided to the successful candidate. Position is 37.5 hours per week over 5 days, between the hours of 8.30am - 5.30pm Retrieve and re-file records as requested, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc. are filed in correct records Ensure records are kept neat and tidy and in good repair with all necessary information recorded correctly on the outer cover Summarising correspondence and medical records Patient deductions Administrative support Provide administrative support to members of the primary health care team in the following areas ensuring practice records are kept up to date where appropriate:- Cytology Pathology results Immunisation recalls Scanning of documentation Requests for copies of medical records from patients and solicitors Registering of new patients Read Coding information into patients medical records Medical reports for Insurance companies etc Incoming post including Royal Mail and hospital Electronic letters (EDIs) Provide cover and support to Secretarial Team Incoming and outgoing emails Confidentiality In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters.They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers.They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & Safety The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, the practice Health & Safety Manual, and the practice Infection Control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general / patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and Diversity The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the Implementation of Services The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate
